notes:
IMD Money Back (MONEYBACK), Money Back Mutual, Robinhood Chain 4663. Website https://imdmoneyback.xyz; X https://x.com/IMDmoneyback. Logo: assets/moneyback.png (1024 square), editable assets/moneyback.svg; one warm-yellow #FFC83D open umbrella with hooked handle on flat navy #17356B.
MoneyBackToken mints exactly 1000000000000000000000000000 minor units once to the launch factory. Factory allocation: swarm seats 10% via MerkleDistributor; requester share 90%, with poolBps 9000 OF THAT REQUESTER SHARE and remainderTo 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dead. Thus 810000000 tokens (81%) seed the pool single-sided, 90000000 tokens (9%) go to the dead address, and 100000000 tokens (10%) go to the swarm. No team token allocation. These economics are launch-task inputs, not extra manifest fields; see docs/requester-share.json and README.md. The dead address is the explicitly requested remainder destination, never an owner or constructor stand-in.
Hook args are $poolManager, $token, $owner; $owner is the paying wallet 0x57797cba5196a87959a0b8f1b8a42e5aed721eac. Payout is that immutable wallet, not RoundPayout. Flags 0x20CC; one token/IMD pool, LP fee 12500, spacing 60. Base hook fee 425 bps on the IMD leg in BOTH directions. Sell-only surcharge 2000 bps decays linearly to zero in 1800 seconds from initialization. Fee parts floor separately. All hook fees stay as IMD ERC-6909 claims; permissionless sweep burns claims and sends IMD only to payout. Never convert hook fees to ETH. IMD-specified swaps (exact-input buys and exact-output sells) revert PartialFill if the adjusted amount is not completely filled; other cases charge actual IMD moved. LP conversions do not incur a sell surcharge: flags deliberately remain fixed.
The installed univ4_hook schema deploys only MoneyBackToken and MoneyBackHook. It has no contracts array or $contract:MoneyBackHook resolver. After their launch, separately deploy RoundPayout($owner) and MoneyBackRouter($poolManager, actual deployed hook address) with script/DeployAuxiliaries.s.sol; its tests validate ownership and address wiring. Do not consider the four-contract deployment complete until both auxiliary receipts exist. Only RoundPayout has owner powers. The wallet must explicitly fund RoundPayout for rounds; sweep never funds it automatically. The router converts users' trading proceeds, not hook fees, through the public native-ETH/IMD pool (fee 10000, spacing 100, no hook).
The brief explicitly supplies initialPrice 79228162514264337593543950336; preserved as protocol provenance. The launch deployer derives the actual opening price from the policy's 2500 IMD whole-supply market cap and final currency ordering. No worker-selected market price or funding is substituted. Worker-selected repairs: atomic refusal of unsafe partial fills; separate, tested auxiliary deployment; SVG plus PNG logo packaging. See docs/AUDIT_RESPONSES.md for all imported findings, validation and remaining operational responsibilities. This repository preparation does not broadcast transactions.
